name: Los Angeles
tagline: From Hollywood's golden-age martinis in 1919 to the viral taco truck on Sunset Boulevard — with the city's priciest menu in between.

Musso & Frank Grill.description: Hollywood's golden-age dining room since 1919. Chaplin, Marilyn Monroe, and Fitzgerald all sat at these same tables.

Somni.description: Los Angeles' most expensive tasting menu: 20 courses of avant-garde Catalan cuisine from chef Aitor Zabala. Three Michelin stars.

Leo's Tacos Truck.description: Los Angeles' most viral al pastor trompo, on Sunset Boulevard.

Philippe the Original.description: The French Dip was born here by accident in 1908, when a roll fell into the roast juice.

Holbox.description: Yucatecan seafood at a counter inside Mercado La Paloma. One Michelin star, an unusual feat for such a casual stall.
